test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: An intricate dance of neurotransmitters in the synaptic cleft plays the crucial role in neural communication.
An intricate dance of neurotransmitters in a synaptic cleft plays a crucial role in neural communication.
The intricate dance of neurotransmitters in the synaptic cleft plays a crucial role in neural communication.
The intricate dance of neurotransmitters in a synaptic cleft plays the crucial role in neural communication.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. The intricate dance of neurotransmitters in the synaptic cleft plays a crucial role in neural communication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This sentence uses the definite article **"the"**, which is appropriate when referring to a specific noun that is known or has been previously mentioned in context. Here, "the synaptic cleft" refers to a specific space involved in neural communication.
 
• The use of the phrase **"plays a crucial role"** is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning clearly.
 
• The subject-verb agreement is correct: **"The intricate dance... plays"**. The singular subject requires the singular verb form "plays."

Correct sentence: *The intricate dance of neurotransmitters in the synaptic cleft plays a crucial role in neural communication.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Incorrect because it uses "the crucial role," which implies there is only one specific crucial role in all contexts, which may not be accurate here.
 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect because it uses "a synaptic cleft," which implies any random synaptic cleft, not a specific one crucial to the context.
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect because it uses "a synaptic cleft" instead of "the synaptic cleft," which fails to indicate a specific known space in the context of neural communication.
